## GEOGRAPHY aggregates
# Source: third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions.md
# Source: third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions.md
# Source: third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions.md
# The examples are documented. The three functions ignore NULL values, and ST_EXTENT is NULL
# where all its values are NULL or empty. Round away floating-point error in spherical bounds.

SELECT ST_UNION_AGG(items) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(-122.4 37.8)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(-122.4 37.8)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(-122.4 37.8)')]) AS items
=> "POINT(-122.4 37.8)"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_UNION_AGG(g), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(1 2, 3 4)')) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), NULL, ST_GEOGPOINT(3, 4)]) g
=> "true"

SELECT ST_CENTROID_AGG(points) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 5), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, -1), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, -1)]) points
=> "POINT(1 1.24961422620969)"

SELECT ST_CENTROID(ST_UNION_AGG(points)) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 5), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, -1), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, -1)]) points
=> "POINT(1 2)"

SELECT ST_CENTROID_AGG(g) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 5), NULL, ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, -1), NULL, ST_GEOGPOINT(1, -1)]) g
=> "POINT(1 1.24961422620969)"

SELECT ROUND(b.xmin, 10) = 172 AND ROUND(b.ymin, 10) = 46 AND ROUND(b.xmax, 10) = 243 AND ROUND(b.ymax, 10) = 70 FROM (SELECT ST_EXTENT(g) AS b FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((-125 48, -124 46, -117 46, -117 49, -125 48))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((172 53, -130 55, -141 70, 172 53))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY')]) g)
=> "true"

SELECT ROUND(b.xmin, 10) = 1 AND ROUND(b.ymin, 10) = 2 AND ROUND(b.xmax, 10) = 3 AND ROUND(b.ymax, 10) = 4 FROM (SELECT ST_EXTENT(g) AS b FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), NULL, ST_GEOGPOINT(3, 4)]) g)
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EXTENT(g) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY), NULL]) g
=> null

SELECT ST_EXTENT(g) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), NULL, ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING EMPTY')]) g
=> null

SELECT TYPEOF(ST_EXTENT(g)) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2)]) g
=> "STRUCT<xmin FLOAT64, ymin FLOAT64, xmax FLOAT64, ymax FLOAT64>"

# Source: BigQuery answers collected by the maintainer.
# ST_UNION_AGG unions its values as ST_UNION does an array, so their order decides the order of
# the output's linestrings and of a polygon's vertices, and a point on another value's line is
# left out.

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_UNION_AGG(g)) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 0, 3 0)')]) g
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 2 0, 3 0)"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_UNION_AGG(g)) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 0, 3 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0)')]) g
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 2 0, 3 0)"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_UNION_AGG(g)) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 2)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 2, 2 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 0, 1 2)')]) g
=> "MULTILINESTRING((0 0, 1 1.00045705372412, 2 2), (0 2, 1 1.00045705372412, 2 0), (1 0, 1 1.00045705372412, 1 2))"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_UNION_AGG(g)) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 0, 1 2)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 2, 2 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 2)')]) g
=> "MULTILINESTRING((1 0, 1 1.00045705372412, 1 2), (0 2, 1 1.00045705372412, 2 0), (0 0, 1 1.00045705372412, 2 2))"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_UNION_AGG(g)) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((1 1, 3 1, 3 3, 1 3, 1 1))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(5 5)')]) g
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POINT(5 5), POLYGON((1 2.0003044086155, 0 2, 0 0, 2 0, 2 1.00015229710421, 3 1, 3 3, 1 3, 1 2.0003044086155)))"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_UNION_AGG(g)) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(5 5)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((1 1, 3 1, 3 3, 1 3, 1 1))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))')]) g
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POINT(5 5), POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 1.00015229710421, 3 1, 3 3, 1 3, 1 2.0003044086155, 0 2, 0 0)))"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_UNION_AGG(g)) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(5, 5)]) g
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POINT(5 5), LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 2 0))"

# Source: BigQuery answers collected by the maintainer.
# Only the highest dimension of all the values contributes to ST_CENTROID_AGG, including the parts
# of collections; each value counts, so repeated polygons and linestrings weigh more, and empty
# values count for nothing.

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_CENTROID_AGG(g)) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGPOINT(100, 30), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0)')]) g
=> "POINT(5 0)"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_CENTROID_AGG(g)) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(100 0, 110 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 10 0, 0 10, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(50, 50)]) g
=> "POINT(3.34995688929909 3.34424564153806)"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_CENTROID_AGG(g)) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POINT(100 30), LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(20 0, 20 30)')]) g
=> "POINT(16.1383904958199 11.3096053110835)"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_CENTROID_AGG(g)) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POINT(100 30), LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(50, 50)]) g
=> "POINT(5 0)"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_CENTROID_AGG(g)) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 10 0, 0 10, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 10 0, 0 10, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((20 0, 30 0, 20 10, 20 0))')]) g
=> "POINT(9.98622947767608 3.38987963577732)"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_CENTROID_AGG(g)) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(20 0, 20 30)')]) g
=> "POINT(13.8452937039799 9.04509379782235)"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_CENTROID_AGG(g)) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGPOINT(-30, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(150, 0)]) g
=> "POINT(0 0)"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_CENTROID_AGG(g)) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 10 0, 0 10, 0 0))')]) g
=> "POINT(3.34995688929909 3.34424564153806)"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_CENTROID_AGG(g)) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2)]) g
=> "POINT(1 2)"

# Source: BigQuery answers collected by the maintainer.
# ST_UNION_AGG and ST_CENTROID_AGG are NULL for no values other than NULL, and the empty
# geography for only empty ones.

SELECT ST_UNION_AGG(g) IS NULL FROM UNNEST(ARRAY<GEOGRAPHY>[]) g
=> "true"

SELECT ST_CENTROID_AGG(g) IS NULL FROM UNNEST(ARRAY<GEOGRAPHY>[]) g
=> "true"

SELECT ST_UNION_AGG(g) IS NULL FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY), NULL]) g
=> "true"

SELECT ST_CENTROID_AGG(g) IS NULL FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY), NULL]) g
=> "true"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_UNION_AGG(g)) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), NULL]) g
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_CENTROID_AGG(g)) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), NULL]) g
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

# Source: BigQuery answers collected by the maintainer.
# ST_EXTENT rounds its bounds outward by one representable value, as ST_BOUNDINGBOX does.

SELECT ST_EXTENT(g) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(10, 90)]) g
=> {"f":[{"v":"-4.9E-324"},{"v":"-4.9E-324"},{"v":"10.000000000000002"},{"v":"90.0"}]}

SELECT ST_EXTENT(g) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGPOINT(170, -5), ST_GEOGPOINT(-170, 5)]) g
=> {"f":[{"v":"169.99999999999997"},{"v":"-5.000000000000001"},{"v":"190.00000000000003"},{"v":"5.000000000000001"}]}

SELECT ST_EXTENT(g) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1)]) g
=> {"f":[{"v":"-4.9E-324"},{"v":"-3.883275617352508E-14"},{"v":"2.0000000000000004"},{"v":"1.0000000000000002"}]}

SELECT ST_EXTENT(g) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1)]) g
=> {"f":[{"v":"-180.0"},{"v":"-90.0"},{"v":"180.0"},{"v":"90.0"}]}

# Source: BigQuery answers collected by the maintainer.
# Unlike ST_BOUNDINGBOX, ST_EXTENT spans all longitudes, without rounding them, where the smallest
# interval that covers its values is 180 degrees long or more, even for a single value: here 170
# degrees, then 190 and 240, and for two linestrings 170, then 190; then exactly 180. The documentation calls the
# result the minimum rectangle that encloses the values:
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions.md

SELECT ST_EXTENT(g) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(85, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(-85, 0)]) g
=> {"f":[{"v":"-85.00000000000001"},{"v":"-4.9E-324"},{"v":"85.00000000000001"},{"v":"4.9E-324"}]}

SELECT ST_EXTENT(g) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(95, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(-95, 0)]) g
=> {"f":[{"v":"-180.0"},{"v":"-4.9E-324"},{"v":"180.0"},{"v":"4.9E-324"}]}

SELECT ST_EXTENT(g) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(120, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(-120, 0)]) g
=> {"f":[{"v":"-180.0"},{"v":"-4.9E-324"},{"v":"180.0"},{"v":"4.9E-324"}]}

SELECT ST_EXTENT(g) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGPOINT(-170, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(-60, 1), ST_GEOGPOINT(60, 2), ST_GEOGPOINT(170, 3)]) g
=> {"f":[{"v":"-180.0"},{"v":"-4.9E-324"},{"v":"180.0"},{"v":"3.000000000000001"}]}

SELECT ST_EXTENT(g) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(-170 0, -60 1, 60 2, 170 3)')]) g
=> {"f":[{"v":"-180.0"},{"v":"-4.9E-324"},{"v":"180.0"},{"v":"3.000000000000001"}]}

SELECT ST_EXTENT(g) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 90 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(100 0, 170 0)')]) g
=> {"f":[{"v":"-4.9E-324"},{"v":"-6.361109362927035E-14"},{"v":"170.00000000000003"},{"v":"6.361109362927035E-14"}]}

SELECT ST_EXTENT(g) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 90 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(100 0, -170 0)')]) g
=> {"f":[{"v":"-180.0"},{"v":"-6.361109362927035E-14"},{"v":"180.0"},{"v":"6.361109362927035E-14"}]}

SELECT ST_EXTENT(g) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(180, 0)]) g
=> {"f":[{"v":"-180.0"},{"v":"-4.9E-324"},{"v":"180.0"},{"v":"4.9E-324"}]}

SELECT ST_EXTENT(g) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGPOINT(-90, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(90, 0)]) g
=> {"f":[{"v":"-180.0"},{"v":"-4.9E-324"},{"v":"180.0"},{"v":"4.9E-324"}]}

SELECT ST_EXTENT(g) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 90 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(100 0, 180 0)')]) g
=> {"f":[{"v":"-180.0"},{"v":"-6.361109362927035E-14"},{"v":"180.0"},{"v":"6.361109362927035E-14"}]}

# Source: BigQuery answers collected by the maintainer.
# BigQuery takes none of the aggregates over a window.

SELECT x, ST_ASTEXT(ST_UNION_AGG(g) OVER (ORDER BY x)), ST_ASTEXT(ST_CENTROID_AGG(g) OVER (ORDER BY x)), ST_EXTENT(g) OVER (ORDER BY x) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS x, ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1) AS g), (2, ST_GEOGPOINT(3, 3))]) ORDER BY x
=> error: Analytic function ST_UNION_AGG is not supported.

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_CENTROID_AGG(g) OVER ()) FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1)]) g
=> error: Analytic function ST_CENTROID_AGG is not supported.

SELECT ST_EXTENT(g) OVER () FROM UNNEST([ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1)]) g
=> error: Analytic function ST_EXTENT is not supported.
